summary.text: Matthew Poulin is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and also ran for Merrimack 9 in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Poulin was one of four Republicans who advanced from the Merrimack 9 primary on September 10, 2024.
In the November 5, 2024 general election he received 11.5 percent of the vote and did not win one of the four seats.
